description: Machine format (wr.calls.v1, testnet): sealed per-call envelopes from the graded-calls ledger. Optional filters: state (grade_state), asset (substring of asset_or_event). Historical record only. Use calls_get for one call's full envelope once you have its call_id, calls_since to sync only what is new, and get_scoreboard instead for the human-readable track record. state matches grade_state exactly; asset is a case-insensitive substring of asset_or_event. If the feed is frozen pending reconciliation, this returns frozen:true with count 0 rather than stale data; if the store file is absent on this deployment, it returns count 0 with a note — neither is an error. Returns {format, frozen, ledger_count, count, calls} with full sealed envelopes. Behaviour: read-only and public — no authentication; every call is logged in aggregate (tool name, query, result count, coarse client class; no IP addresses).

asset.description: Substring match on asset_or_event, e.g. BTC.
